The Subtask Name: Identify the author of Quadragesimo Anno and confirm their death details
Step Range: 0-10
The Oracle: Pope Pius XI died in Vatican City in 1939
Evidence: Steps 0-2 confirm the author is Pope Pius XI; Steps 3-10 confirm his death date (February 10, 1939) and place (Vatican City) through multiple searches and Wikipedia page views.

The Subtask Name: Determine the end year of the Governor post for the city where the author died
Step Range: 11-21
The Oracle: The post ended in 1943 (or the office was abolished/renamed in that year)
Evidence: Steps 11-21 involve repeated attempts by the Planner and WebSurfer to find the end year of the "Governor of the City" post for Vatican City or Rome, but the conversation ends without successfully retrieving the specific year from a source.
